actions.action: Preserve arrival order across every reroute
actions.mechanism: Immutable arrival time and a stable tie-breaker preserve service claims independently of team membership.
actions.implementation: Store write-protected original_arrived_at and intake_sequence. Within each explicit urgency class, select the oldest eligible case across team queues.
actions.check: Reroute an older case twice; verify it precedes newer equally urgent eligible cases. Simultaneous arrivals retain deterministic ordering.
actions.risk: Strict urgency precedence can prolong ordinary-case waits.

actions.action: Enforce eligibility and capacity before assignment
actions.mechanism: Hard qualification gates prevent unsafe routing; roster-derived capacity limits prevent overbooking as shifts change.
actions.implementation: Require verified language, required product expertise, and urgent qualification when applicable. Atomically reserve available roster capacity and revalidate eligibility before committing assignment.
actions.check: Race two assignments for one remaining slot; only one succeeds. Reject unavailable, wrong-language, and urgent-unqualified workers.
actions.risk: Stale qualification or roster records can block valid assignments.

actions.action: Show skill and information blockers separately
actions.mechanism: Independent blocker flags distinguish missing customer information from unavailable expertise without obscuring cases blocked by both.
actions.implementation: Track waiting-for-skill and waiting-for-information separately, with reasons, next actions, and review dates. Display total age from original arrival regardless of blockers.
actions.check: Create cases with either blocker and both. Clear one blocker; verify the other remains and original age never resets.
actions.risk: Unreviewed blockers can become permanent holding states.

actions.action: Correct tags without transferring queue ownership
actions.mechanism: A shared case pool recalculates eligible workers after tag corrections instead of recreating cases in destination queues.
actions.implementation: Version language and product requirements; record correction evidence. For uncertain requirements, hold assignment pending verification. On correction, revalidate or revoke incompatible assignments.
actions.check: Correct a wrong-language tag during routing; verify stale assignment attempts fail and the case retains its original service-order key.
actions.risk: Overly cautious verification can increase waiting-for-information time.

actions.action: Make urgency decisions explicit and reviewable
actions.mechanism: Documented incident criteria determine urgent qualification requirements without using customer status or spending as proxies.
actions.implementation: Require an urgency reason grounded in reported impact or symptoms. Exclude commercial attributes from urgency rules; log overrides and revalidate existing assignments.
actions.check: Change only customer status and spending; urgency remains unchanged. Promote an assigned case to urgent; an unqualified worker loses assignment.
actions.risk: Ambiguous impact reports require human review.

actions.action: Handle uncovered urgent shifts without unsafe fallback
actions.mechanism: A visible coverage-gap workflow preserves urgent cases until qualified capacity exists rather than relaxing assignment requirements.
actions.implementation: When neither trained worker is eligible, mark waiting-for-skill, alert the coverage owner, and show next rostered coverage if known. Retry on roster updates.
actions.check: Run a shift with no eligible urgent worker; verify zero unsafe assignments, a coverage alert, and oldest-first dispatch when coverage returns.
actions.risk: Escalation cannot guarantee that qualified coverage becomes available.

actions.action: Replay adversarial routing scenarios before release
actions.mechanism: Deterministic event simulation exposes ordering, qualification, and capacity failures that ordinary single-case tests can miss.
actions.implementation: Build a controllable-clock test harness covering simultaneous arrivals, tag corrections, information replies, concurrent dispatch, shift boundaries, and uncovered urgent shifts.
actions.check: Assert immutable arrival timestamps, no ineligible assignments, no capacity overruns, correct blocker visibility, and oldest-eligible selection within urgency classes after every event.
actions.risk: Passing simulations does not establish real-world response-time improvements.
